version.changelog: Added: 新浪财经7x24小时实时快讯 + 新浪财经点击量排行 + 美股TOP100. Enhanced: platform coverage expanded from 4 to 9 sources. Expanded: screening criteria refined for real-time news value.

llm.summary: This skill is a straightforward finance-news summarizer with disclosed web fetching and only an optional, user-approved package install suggestion.

dimensions.detail: The requested environment use is limited to fetching named public finance/news ranking pages and summarizing selected items; no local files, credentials, or private data are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill has no automatic installer or bundled executable code, but it suggests an optional unpinned `pip install akshare` command for users who need real-time market-data functionality.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger text is somewhat broad for finance-news queries, but the runtime instructions stay within summarizing finance headlines and explicitly exclude real-time K-line market analysis.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, background workers, tool modification, memory writes, or automatic package installation are present in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact consistently describes a daily finance hot-list/news summary skill and its web-fetching behavior is directly aligned with that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want a finance-news summary helper that fetches public ranking pages. Be aware that it may activate for broad finance-news prompts, and do not run the optional AkShare install unless you choose to add real-time market-data tooling, preferably in a virtual environment with a reviewed version.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger phrases could cause extra activations for generic finance-news requests, but this is a scope-quality issue rather than a material security concern because the skill only fetches public finance pages and summarizes them.
[T08] unexpected: The optional `pip install akshare` recommendation is not required for the core daily-news function and is unpinned, so users should treat it as a supply-chain hygiene note; the artifact does not install it automatically.
